author: blu
body: A TLS 1.3 server on a real socket, so that something other than our own client can be the thing that talks to it.

author: blu
body: The server's X25519 private key and handshake random. Fixed, because a test that cannot be reproduced is not a test; a real server takes both from entropy.

author: blu
body: The connection loop. Read, drain, and stop when the endpoint has both completed the handshake and received an application record -- at which point the same bytes go back, encrypted under the server application key, and the harness compares them.
